authoring_metadata.description: Owner-approved foundational direction. Reduced MPC-stage feed, relatively restrained processing: SP 0 dB, interstage -2 dB, output +2 dB. Creative listening reference only: the owner's 2001-era drum-impact target is a musical intent, not a claim of emulating any producer, album, hardware chain or verified historical signal path. Not a factory preset.
authoring_metadata.audition_notes: Owner audition (2026-10-07): proven useful as a starting point on finished beats. Ratings not yet recorded (see AUDITION_LOG.csv). Intensity class: to be set by owner audition, not by gain arithmetic.
